# ANGRAMM®

> ANGRAMM is a creative agency and audiovisual production company. Driven by major collaborations with high-profile partners, we bring our creative and technical expertise to any industry, both in France and internationally.

ANGRAMM was born in Marseille. We imagine, shoot and finish films for brands, clubs and artists, from street documentary to full CGI. We work as one crew, from the first idea to the final grade, with the same obsession: images that feel true to the places and the people they come from.

Based in Marseille, France. Contact: contact@angramm.com

## Films

- [OLYMPIQUE DE MARSEILLE · Official campaign 26/27](https://angramm.com/work/om/) (2026): A film for Olympique de Marseille unveiling the 2026/27 kit. Live action and CGI meet in a cinematic expedition, from the stands to the heart of a blue-lit volcano.
- [MIZUNO x VRUNK · Rio de Janeiro](https://angramm.com/work/mizuno-rio/) (2026): A Rio de Janeiro favela lights up: the Mizuno × Vrunk collection told through hustle, energy and light, from rooftop barbers to a logo glowing over the city.
- [PUMA · Olympique de Marseille third jersey 25/26](https://angramm.com/work/om-cma-cgm/): PUMA and Olympique de Marseille unveil the 2025/26 third jersey at the port of Marseille, shot among the containers and the dockers who keep the port running.
- [OLYMPIQUE DE MARSEILLE · Les Marseillaises, Prise du Vel](https://angramm.com/work/om-prise-du-vel/) (2026): Les Marseillaises take over the Vélodrome: a campaign for the Olympique de Marseille women's team, from neighbourhood pitches and hairdressers to a packed stadium, for their match against Montpellier at the Orange Vélodrome.
- [LACOSTE FW26 · Family 3.0](https://angramm.com/work/lacoste/) (2026): An elevator, a single floor and a vinyl session: Lacoste's FW26 collection, created with Family 3.0 and filmed in chiaroscuro between record shelves and sound systems.
